title: Explorer route screen
responsibility: Connects a framework route to the explorer console and a supplied screen component.

inputs.name: HarnessScreen.title
inputs.description: The name of this explorer screen, which the component places in the document's title element as '{title} · Harness'. It is required and used as given, with no trimming, validation or length limit, so an empty string produces a document title of ' · Harness'.

inputs.name: HarnessScreen.content
inputs.description: The component that renders this screen, which HarnessScreen passes unchanged to HarnessConsole as its content. It is required with no default, so every page must supply its own.

outputs.name: HarnessScreen
outputs.description: The rendered markup: a document title of '{title} · Harness' and a HarnessConsole bound to the current URL's pathname minus its first 8 characters ('/harness') plus the query string, so it updates whenever the route or query changes. The '/harness' prefix is not checked, and the navigate function passed to the console calls SvelteKit's goto with '/harness' + path, replaceState set to replace, noScroll: true and keepFocus: true.
